name: Thelgen Rock
summary: In the Wetlands, Thelgen Rock’s caverns draw miners after volatile Incendicite Ore. Venomous spiders fill the passages.

sections.title: A Web-Choked Cavern
sections.body: Thelgen Rock cuts into the mountain wall between the Wetlands and Loch Modan. Aggressive spiders crowd its web-choked passages, and their venom makes every step perilous. Still, miners and adventurers brave the tunnels for the valuable Incendicite Ore in the rock.

faq.answer: Large poisonous spiders crowd Thelgen Rock’s caverns. Webs choke the winding tunnels, where travelers can be cornered and overcome by venomous bites.

faq.q: Why do prospectors and miners come here?
faq.answer: The caves hold rich seams of fiery, volatile Incendicite Ore, sought by dwarven prospectors and engineers. Despite the spiders, miners enter to gather samples from the cave walls.
Thelgen Rock lies along the Wetlands’ southern mountain ridge, south of the main road between Menethil Harbor and the Dun Algaz mountain pass.

angles.text: Rare Incendicite Ore deposits lie deep within Thelgen Rock. Prospectors venture beneath the mountain to find them, despite the danger.
